title: FEC closes MUR 7157 with no-reason-to-believe findings
summary: The Commission approved no-reason-to-believe findings on the coordinated-communications and related reporting allegations in MUR 7157 and closed the file.

data.name: FEC disposition of MUR 7157
data.description: The Federal Election Commission approved no-reason-to-believe findings concerning alleged excessive or prohibited in-kind contributions and related reporting violations arising from alleged coordinated communications, and closed MUR 7157.
decisions: Find no reason to believe Hillary for America and the DNC accepted or failed to report excessive or prohibited in-kind contributions under the cited provisions.
Find no reason to believe Bob Creamer and Scott Foval made excessive in-kind contributions.

Find no reason to believe Priorities USA Action, Democracy Partners, Americans United for Change, The Foval Group, Voces de la Frontera, and Alliance for Retired Americans made excessive or prohibited in-kind contributions.
Approve the Factual and Legal Analysis and close the file.
